review_candidates.title: DevOps Engineer
review_candidates.description: We are looking for a DevOps Engineer who thrives on making development and operations teams more efficient. In this role, you'll design and build tooling that abstracts away complexity, empowering developers to spend more time focused on building great products. If you enjoy solving problems, streamlining workflows, and driving productivity across teams, this is an opportunity to make a big impact. Who are we? Buyers Edge Platform stands at the forefront of revolutionizing the foodservice industry through technology, purchasing power and partnerships. We are dedicated to empowering stakeholders across the entire foodservice ecosystem (operators, distributors, manufacturers) with efficiency and unprecedented visibility. With a diverse portfolio of over a dozen brands, our mission is clear: to reduce costs, streamline the foodservice supply chain, and propel the industry from manual to automated. Today, we are one of the largest players in foodservice, with over 200K operator locations across North America and over $50 billion of aggregated spend volume. Our commitment to foodservice excellence is proven in four distinct areas of value: Digital Procurement Network, Fresh Solutions, Supply Chain Management, and Software. Buyers Edge Platform is not just a provider – we are a strategic partner on the journey towards a more efficient, connected, and automated future for the foodservice industry. We are focused on performance, not presence. What matters is not that you are sitting in front of your computer from 9am to 5pm, but rather that you build highly effective and efficient software within agreed timelines. In practice, this might mean working extra hours some days to hit that while having other days that allow for more free time and recovery. Our goal is for Buyers Edge Platform to be a place where people are able to work in a way that is the most efficient and effective for them. This will enable us all to enjoy the solutions we build and the team we are on. This position may require frequent in person work. We are unable to offer work sponsorship for this role. We are seeking a DevOps Engineer who will be help improve the reliability, cost efficiency and operational efficiency of our hosted infrastructure and internally developed applications that power the business. Your impact: Support and improve our CI/CD pipeline tools to support the development teams working on a variety of software products. Create relationships with the development teams to progress towards common goals. Monitoring and maintaining computer systems and networks. Infrastructure as code, develop tools to deploy infrastructure for development environments. Containerize applications to improve deployments and application resilience. Work closely with development and quality assurance teams to streamline and improve workflows. Ensure infrastructure can scale dynamically and recover from disaster scenarios. Responding in a timely manner to service issues and requests Good understanding of security benchmarking Managing development resources and access controls Occasional after-hours work Internal tooling development to improve operational efficiency and self-service solutions About you: Four-year degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Information Security or equivalent 2 years’ experience in a DevOps position 3 years’ experience in Software Engineering. 2 years’ experience with Amazon Web Services Experience running Kubernetes / EKS in production environments. Competent at least one scripting language such as Bash, Python, or GOLang. GOLang is preferred. Familiarity with CI tools like CircleCI, Jenkins, Github Actions and GitLab Professional experience with configuration management tools like Ansible, Puppet and Chef. Strong knowledge with an orchestrator tool such as Terraform or Cloud Formation. GIT Experience with monitoring tools, APM, Logging and Infrastructure. Brief Experience working with MySQL, Amazon Aurora, and Redshift. Not sure you meet every qualification? Studies show that diverse applicants often hesitate to apply unless they check every box. At Buyers Edge Platform, we value authenticity and inclusion—if you're excited about the role, we encourage you to apply. You might be exactly who we’re looking for! What's in this for you? Great benefits from day one. We offer medical, dental, vision, FSA, company-paid life insurance, and more—plus a 401(k) with company match. Grow with us. Enjoy strong training, development, and competitive pay. Work-life balance. Our flexible PTO policy lets you take time when you need it—no accrual required. We welcome all. We are committed to creating a diverse environment and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to actual or perceived race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth and pregnancy-related conditions), gender identity or expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital status, military service and veteran status, physical or mental disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws and ordinances.

review_candidates.title: Customer Service Representative - English ( B2-C1 )
review_candidates.description: Company Description Raya CX provides next-generation business process outsourcing and customer experience management for clients across multiple industries. Since 2001, the company has been a trusted partner for customer service, technical support, and global services to Fortune 1000 organizations in North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. Raya CX operates from highly competitive and skilled labor markets, offering integrated outsourcing solutions tailored to client needs. Its services are supported by advanced technology, robust operational strategies, and a culture of continuous improvement and innovation. Team members join a dynamic environment focused on delivering superior customer experiences and sustainable value. Role Description This is a full-time, on-site Customer Service Representative role based in Qesm El Maadi. The representative will handle inbound and outbound customer interactions in English (B2–C1 level), responding to inquiries, resolving issues, and providing accurate information about products and services. Daily tasks include managing calls, emails, or chats, documenting customer interactions, and following established processes to ensure timely and effective resolutions. The role involves maintaining high levels of customer satisfaction by practicing empathy, active listening, and clear communication, while meeting performance targets such as response time and quality standards. The representative will collaborate with team members and supervisors, escalate complex cases when necessary, and adhere to company policies and data protection requirements. Qualifications Strong customer-facing skills, including experience as a Customer Service Representative and in Customer Service. Proficiency in Customer Support with a focus on resolving inquiries efficiently and maintaining Customer Satisfaction. Ability to contribute to an excellent Customer Experience through clear communication, empathy, and problem-solving. English language proficiency at B2–C1 level, with clear spoken and written communication. Comfort working in an on-site, structured environment with rotating shifts if required. Basic computer literacy, including CRM systems, email, and chat tools. Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to handle multiple interactions simultaneously. Previous experience in contact centers, BPO, or customer-facing roles is an advantage. High school diploma or equivalent required; post-secondary education is a plus.

Accounts Payable Lead Cairo, Egypt Role Overview You will be part of a wider/expanding EMEA Shared Service Centre (SSC) team that are based in the UK, South Africa, Egypt and Turkey. The whole of the SSC is around 230 people across 3 different functions - Finance, Credit & Collections and Supply Chain. We support over 20 countries and speak around 40 different languages. Functional Leadership Strong accounts payable technical knowledge to support the team quality and integrity of financial information provided by the SSC Ensuring compliance with SOAR, global policies and local regulations, and that the appropriate controls are operational in order to maintain the quality and integrity of financial information. Business Relationship Management Responsible for direct contact with business partners. To develop and sustain these relationships, understanding countries evolving needs and situations, while ensuring process compliance and effectiveness. Performance Leadership Ensure that team processes perform to agreements levels and reach objectives and key performance indicators on monthly base. Perform query management, identification, problem solve and resolution of issues Performing ad-hoc analysis as required Ensure completion of Month End tasks and reporting, such as account analysis and KPI/Metric reporting Supporting the company in any projects designed to improve the SSC Accounts Payable or Procure to Pay process. Process excellence To deliver effectiveness and efficiency process improvements using Lean tools and methodology To ensure through active role modelling that OPEX (Operational and Process Excellence) methodology is embedded in the DNA of the team Required Qualifications And Experience Accounting bacilluria or other relevant qualification or studying towards diploma relevant qualification. Strong previous experience of working within/with an accounts payable department for a multi-national organization Previous experience of managing an accounts payable team would be an advantage and ideally in a multicultural company environment Experience in a multinational organization, preferably from the FMCG sector. Excellent knowledge of MS Excel + PowerPoint + Power BI + ideally SAP 4Hana. Fluent in English Preferred Knowledge Strong experience of working with SAP Experience of working to tight deadlines The ability to use initiative and be proactive in anticipating problems which may occur Accuracy – Strong attention to detail A sense of urgency Adopt a LEAN/OPEX mindset in all areas of the team Skills & Behaviours You’ll Need Leadership skills High level of integrity Problem solving attitude High degree of initiative Easy relationship approach Excellent communication skills (via different media) About Us SC Johnson is a fifth-generation family company built on a spirit of adventure and winning the right way. review_candidates.title: Copilot Presales Specialist
review_candidates.description: Job Summary The Microsoft Copilot Presales Specialist is responsible for driving customer adoption of Microsoft Copilot solutions by connecting business challenges to AI-powered outcomes. Working closely with Account Managers, Customer Executives, Licensing Specialists, Solution Architects, Microsoft field teams, and Data & AI Specialists, this role identifies, qualifies, and advances customer opportunities focused on Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, AI Agents, and Copilot-led business transformation. The role requires a practical understanding of how Microsoft Fabric, Azure AI, Power Platform, and related Microsoft workloads can support Copilot scenarios, while partnering with the appropriate specialists when customer needs extend into Data & AI, application modernization, or platform-specific solution design. Note: SoftwareOne is an AI-forward company . We actively use AI across our business to improve productivity, decision-making, and outcomes, and we are intentional about hiring people who are curious, hands-on, and eager to leverage AI as technology evolves. Role & Responsibilities Identify, qualify, and advance Microsoft Copilot and AI opportunities across existing and new customer accounts, building a healthy pipeline aligned with customer priorities and SoftwareOne’s growth objectives. Partner with Account Managers and Customer Executives to develop account strategies, pipeline growth plans, and demand-generation activities focused on Microsoft Copilot and AI solutions. Engage business and technology stakeholders to uncover strategic objectives, operational challenges, productivity gaps, and AI transformation priorities, translating customer needs into relevant Microsoft solutions. Lead customer discovery, envisioning sessions, workshops, assessments, and executive briefings to identify high-value AI use cases, readiness gaps, licensing considerations, and success criteria. Position Microsoft Copilot as part of a broader Microsoft AI strategy, connecting Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, AI Agents, Power Platform, Microsoft Fabric, and Azure AI to measurable business outcomes while engaging technical specialists when deeper expertise is required. Develop compelling business cases, solution roadmaps, executive presentations, and value realization frameworks that demonstrate the business impact of AI investments, including productivity gains, workflow automation, improved employee experience, and operational efficiency. Guide customers through AI readiness and adoption considerations, including governance, security, compliance, change management, executive sponsorship, stakeholder alignment, and strategies for moving initiatives from pilot to production. Coordinate cross-functional technical resources to develop demonstrations, proof-of-value engagements, pilots, funded initiatives, and solution recommendations that accelerate customer decisions and adoption. Build strong relationships with Microsoft sellers, specialists, and Partner Development Managers to leverage co-sell opportunities, Microsoft funding programs, assessments, and partner incentives that accelerate customer engagement and investment. Serve as a subject matter expert and internal AI advocate, staying current on Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, AI Agents, Microsoft 365, and the broader Microsoft AI ecosystem while delivering enablement sessions and sharing best practices with sales, presales, and customer success teams. Maintain accurate opportunity data, activities, and forecasting in Salesforce, while contributing reusable sales assets, success stories, competitive insights, and best practices that support SoftwareOne’s Microsoft AI strategy. 5% for potential occasional travel to visit customers or internal meetings. Job Requirements What you offer Demonstrated experience using AI in a practical, applied way — such as improving workflows, automating tasks, enabling better decision‑making, or increasing impact in prior roles. This does not require deep technical or engineering expertise in AI; we value applied use, experimenting, and a mindset of curiosity and continuous learning. 5+ years of experience in Microsoft sales, presales, consulting, solution specialist, or other customer-facing technology roles, with a demonstrated ability to influence complex technology decisions. Strong experience with Microsoft technologies, particularly Microsoft 365, Modern Work, Copilot, Power Platform, Security, or related solutions. Familiarity with Azure, Data & AI, Microsoft Fabric, and Azure AI is highly beneficial. Strong understanding of Microsoft Copilot and AI capabilities, including Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, AI Agents, and how these solutions can support broader AI transformation initiatives. Demonstrated experience engaging and presenting to executive, business, and technology stakeholders, including the ability to facilitate strategic conversations with CIO, CTO, CDO, HR, Finance, Operations, and business leadership teams. Proven ability to lead discovery, AI readiness, and business outcome conversations, identifying customer challenges and translating them into relevant Microsoft solutions and actionable AI strategies. Strong business acumen and value-selling capabilities, including experience developing business cases, value propositions, ROI models, solution narratives, or value realization frameworks that connect technology investments to measurable outcomes. Understanding of AI adoption and transformation considerations, including productivity, automation, governance, security, compliance, change management, user adoption, and organizational readiness. Strong commercial awareness and understanding of the technology sales lifecycle, including opportunity identification, qualification, pipeline development, conversion, expansion, and customer value realization. Demonstrated ability to collaborate across cross-functional teams, including sales, presales, solution architecture, licensing, delivery, customer success, Microsoft, and partner teams to advance complex customer opportunities. Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts into compelling business value and establish trusted-advisor relationships with stakeholders at multiple levels. Curiosity and a continuous-learning mindset, with demonstrated practical use of AI to improve productivity, automate tasks, support decision-making, or enhance business processes. Microsoft certifications such as MS-900, AZ-900, AI-900, PL-900, DP-600, Microsoft Copilot for Microsoft 365, Microsoft Applied Skills: Copilot Studio, or related certifications are preferred. Experience with Copilot deployments, Copilot Studio, AI Agents, adoption planning, change management, or business value consulting is strongly preferred. The preceding job profile has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by associates within this role. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required. Additional duties may be assigned and may be subject to change at any time due to reasonable accommodation or other reasons. Success Criteria Revenue influenced through Microsoft Copilot-led opportunities, including qualified expansion paths into adjacent Microsoft workloads through collaboration with the appropriate specialist teams. Customer adoption, expansion, and value realization for Microsoft Copilot-led initiatives, including Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, and AI Agent scenarios, with effective orchestration of Data & AI, Power Platform, Azure AI, or Microsoft Fabric specialists when adjacent opportunities are identified. Organizational Alignment Collaborate closely with Account Management, Presales, Solution Architecture, Delivery, Licensing, and Microsoft teams to advance Copilot and AI opportunities and deliver a seamless customer experience. Contribute to a culture of shared accountability, innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning while supporting SoftwareOne’s strategy to accelerate customer AI adoption and maximize the value of Microsoft investments. This role reports to the Hyperscaler Presales Director . What we offer Generous pay with bonus structure (quarterly or bi-annual depending on the role) Independent environment without a lot of red tape where you are empowered to make decisions Substantial benefits package that includes: Full suite of medical coverage with A+ carriers, Dental, and Vision with strong employer contributions plus additional voluntary coverage available for Pets, Identity Theft Protection, Accident & Critical Illness 401k program with employer matching 50% up to the first 10% of employee’s contributions Wellness plan that includes credits to premiums and employer contributions towards the savings plan of your choice Access to EAP and concierge services plus pre-paid legal at no cost Abundant time off that includes paid holidays, floating holidays, your birthday off, a volunteer day, and discretionary time off (DTO) Employee stock purchase plan Learning and development opportunities galore, tuition reimbursement, and much more! Specific to Nashville and Milwaukee-based office employees : company-paid parking Winning culture, inclusive environment, and friendly people all over the world A remote-friendly organization, with colleagues working remotely either part or full-time Target compensation for this role will be $100K - $115K USD (mix of base salary and bonus). Actual offers may be higher or lower than this range and will be determined based on a variety of factors, including (but not limited to) candidates’ qualifications, experience, education, and work location. We are not able to consider candidates residing in the state of Hawaii currently. Company description SoftwareOne is a global provider of software and cloud solutions. With a presence in over 70 countries and more than 12,000 professionals, we help organizations optimize software investments, modernize applications, and unlock the value of cloud, data, and AI. Our people are at the core of everything we do. We enable collaboration across borders, continuous learning, and opportunities to grow in a fast-evolving technology landscape. Whether your focus is on technology, customer success, or business operations, your ideas matter, and your contributions make a difference. Join a global team where you can build your skills, work with leading technologies, and make a real impact for our customers.

review_candidates.title: Senior Engineer, Digital Design Engineering
review_candidates.description: About Analog Devices Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X. Senior Engineer, Digital Design Engineering Key Responsibilities Create, enhance, and maintain SystemVerilog/UVM verification environments, checkers, scoreboards, assertions, and functional coverage models. Develop comprehensive verification plans and Metric Driven verification closure through code coverage, functional coverage, assertion coverage, and regression analysis. Develop constrained-random and directed test scenarios targeting functional, security, and corner-case behaviors. Maintaining and upgrading existing testbenches to accommodate new features. review_candidates.title: Senior Software Engineer - Husky Storage
review_candidates.description: Husky is what we call the distributed, petabyte-scale columnar event store at the heart of our Event Platform, which powers dozens of Datadog’s most popular products – Logs, RUM, APM, Cloud Network Monitoring, Netflow, and many more. Husky was built from the ground up at Datadog to store and query massive volumes of event data at low cost, with data fully queryable within seconds of arrival. As a Senior Software Engineer on this team, you'll work hands-on with a distributed storage system at petabyte scale, and help us evolve our platform to support the next level of scale that will power the AI era. We will move from a custom storage format towards open standards (Parquet, Arrow, DataFusion) enabling on prem solutions, increasingly complex analytical/batch workloads, and powering AI observability, sustainably into the future. You'll partner closely with Husky Ingestion, Metadata, and Platform, and increasingly with Lakehouse on the Iceberg-compatible boundary between Husky and analytical/batch workloads. You will also work with the open source community to build the next generation of reusable software solutions that can be operated at scale. Datadog has a culture that is increasingly rare in mature technology companies. We are an engineering driven, bottom up, high agency/high responsibility culture–where everyone is empowered and expected to drive the technological and strategic direction of the business over time. We are a blameless culture where we believe supporting each other through challenges produces the best outcomes over time and our track record corroborates this. We are open source champions. We believe in the flexibility of working remotely but also the value of bringing people together across our various offices worldwide–and our offices are nice places to work. What You’ll Do: Drive Husky to the next level of adoption by migrating our storage format to open source Parquet and re-imagine compaction on a format-agnostic, DataFusion-based substrate Drive concrete cost-reduction work: block-level inverted index compression, combining the database with external objects at the row level, and storage tiering/caching Scale our solution to enable customers to manage event versioning at scale, using temporal-database techniques. Play an influential role in operating and deciding how to best operate our service going forward. Work across the write path (with Ingestion) and toward a cleaner Iceberg-based handoff to ADP/Lakehouse for batch/analytical workloads Who You Are: Enthusiastic and experienced with large-scale distributed systems and/or storage engines Comfortable with improving and operating large distributed systems that customers rely on for critical business functions Strong fundamentals in columnar/file storage formats (Parquet, ORC, Arrow) or comparable systems Bonus: experience with Go, Java, or Rust; with compaction or compression/encoding schemes (RLE, dictionary, delta, gorilla); with object storage (S3/GCS/Azure Blob) at scale, including caching and cost optimization; with Kafka and stream processing; or with Kubernetes Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply. Benefits and Growth: New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing Intradepartmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking An inclusive company culture, access to Inclusion Talks Free, global mental health benefits for employees and dependents age 6+ Competitive global benefits Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog. Datadog offers a competitive salary and equity package, and may include variable compensation. Actual compensation is based on factors such as the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience. In addition, Datadog offers a wide range of best in class, comprehensive and inclusive employee benefits for this role including healthcare, dental, parental planning, and mental health benefits, a 401(k) plan and match, paid time off, fitness reimbursements, and a discounted employee stock purchase plan. The reasonably estimated yearly salary for this role at Datadog is: $192,000—$240,000 USD About Datadog: Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence. Learn more about #DatadogLife on Instagram, LinkedIn, and Datadog Learning Center. Equal Opportunity at Datadog: Datadog is proud to offer equal employment opportunity to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and other characteristics protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. Here are our Candidate Legal Notices for your reference. If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process, please complete this form. This form is for accommodation requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications. review_candidates.title: Senior Software Developer (JCP Core Foundation Licensing and Quotation)
review_candidates.description: If you want to build and own the systems that decide what JetBrains customers are entitled to use and bill them accurately for it, this is for you. You will focus on designing backend services, keeping complex commercial flows correct, and tackling hard distributed systems challenges on the critical path of every paid request. About JetBrains We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale. What You’ll Do At JetBrains, the Cloud Platform department builds the underlying infrastructure that powers authentication, paid capabilities, usage metering, and accounting. Within this department, the Licensing & Billing team sits right at the center of our commercial model, turning what a customer buys into what they are actually allowed to use, and accounting for that consumption accurately enough to bill on. The complexity of our entitlement, quota, and metering systems continues to grow. In this role, you will own the correctness and evolution of these backend services, take full ownership of end-to-end data flows, tackle distributed consistency across unreliable upstream systems, and ensure revenue-affecting data migrations happen cleanly without taking services offline. Day To Day, You Will Design, build, and operate backend services that decide what a customer is entitled to and what their usage costs. Own flows end to end, from ingesting licensing and purchase data from upstream systems to enforcing quotas and recording consumption. Evolve our domain model to handle new commercial structures, combining seat-based plans and usage-based models. Design integrations with external systems, ensuring correctness through idempotency, ordering, reconciliation, and eventual consistency. Plan and execute live data migrations using feature flags, dual writes, backfills, and verification at every stage. Build observability into our systems by defining invariants, metrics, and alerts to catch silent divergence before customers do. Design internal APIs with explicit focus on versioning, backward compatibility, and developer experience for other JetBrains teams. Improve system performance and reliability under continuous production load while decommissioning legacy subsystems. Write integration tests against real dependencies and maintain reliable test infrastructure. Investigate production incidents, find root causes, and follow through on lasting fixes. What You’ll Bring An engineer’s dedication to accuracy, especially in domains where system errors have direct financial impact. Pragmatic judgment when designing distributed systems where correctness under unreliable delivery is the main constraint. A habit of trusting metrics, traces, and logs to understand production behavior rather than relying on assumptions. Comfort navigating and simplifying large existing codebases containing legacy decisions. Clear, direct communication skills to agree on API contracts across teams with different priorities. A focus on testing as an essential design tool rather than an afterthought. What You’ll Need A proven track record of building and operating backend services on the JVM platform using Kotlin or Java. A solid working knowledge of relational databases, including transactions, isolation levels, locking, indexing, and live schema migrations (PostgreSQL preferred). A deep understanding of distributed systems patterns, such as idempotency, retry strategies, eventual consistency, and data reconciliation. Practical experience making live data migrations or system changes without downtime using feature flags and staged rollouts. Experience designing versioned, backward-compatible APIs for other engineering teams. Hands-on experience with event-driven architectures and message brokers like Kafka. The ability to diagnose, debug, and resolve production incidents in complex environments. Proficiency in both written and spoken English. What Success Looks Like Success in this role means building a bulletproof entitlement and metering foundation that product teams can trust without hesitation. You will have successfully migrated live commercial systems to support new billing models without downtime or data divergence. Silent errors will be caught automatically by system invariants before affecting users, and internal teams will integrate seamlessly with your clean, versioned APIs. Why join JetBrains? Strong base salary. We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience. Flexible work location. Enjoy the freedom to work from home or from the office. Remote work. Spend up to 30 days per year working remotely from abroad. Extra time off. More days to relax, recharge, and do the things you love. Medical insurance allowance. Enjoy peace of mind for you and your family Learning and development opportunities. Access to conferences, courses, and language classes. Relocation support. We help make your move as smooth and stress-free as possible. (keep if relevant for the role) Language classes. Pick up the local language or sharpen your English skills. Fuel your day. Enjoy a hot meal or receive a lunch allowance on workdays. Mental health support. To help you feel your best, we provide easy access to professional mental health services. Sports benefit. Enjoy an on-site gym or sports club stipend. Internal events. Join company-wide celebrations and team gatherings. Some benefits may vary depending on location. We are an equal opportunity employer We know great ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. That’s why we do our best to create an open and inclusive workplace – one that welcomes everyone regardless of their background, identity, religion, age, accessibility needs, or orientation. We process the data provided in your job application in accordance with the Recruitment Privacy Policy.

review_candidates.title: Principal Software Engineer (Remote, United Kingdom)
review_candidates.description: Job Summary JOB DESCRIPTION – Principal Engineer Location: Remote, United Kingdom Division: TM1 Data Apps Contract Terms: Permanent, 40hours per week THE TEAM The TM1 Data Apps area is a group of Ticketmaster teams that provides Reporting, Marketing and Real Time data insights to our clients and partners, following a recent restructure the teams are now focused on working towards a common data source and accelerating our development of features and capabilities for our clients. THE JOB Ticketmaster Data Apps is looking for an experienced, motivated, and self-driven candidate who can work across the teams to foster collaboration, introduce best practices, share learnings and support the Engineering Director with designing and engineering larger initiatives within the teams. Now is an exciting time to join the team and make a real difference as well as showcase your design and architecture skills as we shape the next generation of data in ticketing with intelligent profile, AI initiatives, integration with various components of the TM ecosystem, and overall, building a world-class system. If you are the sort of person that enjoys a fast-paced work environment, is able to quickly pick-up cutting-edge technologies and product concepts, and has the desire to experiment with and evaluate new technological paths forward, this is the role for you. What You Will Be Doing Design and develop new systems and implement enhancements to existing systems, breaking down complex problems into essential components and building efficient solutions. Work with product teams to understand large units of development and the impact on the teams specifically to identify areas of reuse across the teams to eliminate wasteful development. Own and evolve technical strategy and architectural direction across all three teams. Review existing infrastructure and work with the teams to enhance and refactor to modern architectures again focusing on resuse and simplification, develop and design high-traffic, large scale software applications and data flow processes, infrastructure for deploying and long-term maintenance of the systems. Design and develop peripheral systems and processes - monitoring and alerting services, automated build and deployment pipelines, systems for gathering application performance metrics, ensuring efficiency in cost. Push best practices in system development ranging from test coverage, use of enterprise standards, adherence to target architecture, high-availability and scalability, low latency, and fault-tolerance, thus ensuring delivery of high-quality systems. Establish shared engineering standards, patterns, and guardrails, and ensure their consistent adoption across the wider function. Identify systemic technical risks and dependencies that span multiple products or teams, and lead their resolution. Work with the teams to design and build a comprehensive QA platform/solution to ensure quality and speed of delivery. Own solution design discussions and meetings to ensure systems are aligned in the bigger scheme of things. Also evaluating new tools and technologies for feasibility, cost and subsequent use in the company and teams Influence longer-term technology decisions and investment priorities with senior engineering, product, and business stakeholders. Ensure that solutions developed within individual teams support enterprise architecture, scalability, reliability, and security objectives. Act as a principal technical advisor on decisions with significant or long-term implications beyond the immediate area. Leading teams in development of new systems and new initiatives by executing the duties mentioned above as well as guiding, mentoring and in general helping team members in learning applications, technologies, best practices and processes. Reviewing code for quality, correctness and efficiency. Owning specific work unit deliveries from a day-to-day standpoint – participating in daily agile stand-ups, escalating blockers to stakeholders, ensuring timely completion of tasks & overall project & spring goals. Communicating updates to stakeholders and working with them on timelines. Working with specific team members to aid them in developing their skills. WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW (or TECHNICAL SKILLS) Need to know/be able to do Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related technical field. Proficiency in one or more of the following programming languages –Java, Typescript, NodeJS and willingness to learn the others. 5+ years of experience in building high-traffic web applications and deploying to production with a focus on quality and long-term maintainability. Experience in working with cloud-based platforms (preferably AWS). Experience supporting live applications - good debugging skills, reading logs, reading application dashboards like Grafana / AWS monitors (e.g., CloudWatch) - identifying issues and solving them efficiently. Experience writing SQL queries, working with SQL (e.g., MySQL) and NoSQL databases (e.g., DynamoDB). Experience working with Infrastructure as code tools like Terraform, Kubernetes, and Helm. Experience working with code and build tools like Gitlab, CI/CD, Jenkins, and Sonar. Experience working in an Agile team - attending stand-ups, delivering work in a time-boxed setting, etc... Ability to work under some pressure e.g., handling production issues, on-call support for live systems, etc... An overall calm personality - ability to see the big picture and how the current team / task / project fits into it. Nice to know/good to have Experience in the entertainment and/or online ticketing industry Familiarity with operating across diverse cultural and regulatory environments (Europe, Asia, South America) Understanding of your own usage of AI (Claude or similar) in the SDLC You (behavioural Skills) Strong verbal communication, ability to clearly communicate ideas, work status, advocate for (or against) a particular approach or design. Documentation skills - ability to make the path easier for new team members / new hires / interns by organizing knowledge in Confluence, wiki, or similar. Ability to manage self and own time, deliver work on time, evaluate and estimate work. Ability to work with various teams, including tech and product, incorporate their inputs into the work being done, and manage expectations on issues & enhancements. Experience working across multiple teams and working on cross team projects. Desire and experience mentoring junior members of the teams LIFE AT TICKETMASTER We are proud to be a part of Live Nation Entertainment, the world’s largest live entertainment company. Our vision at Ticketmaster is to connect people around the world to the live events they love. As the world’s largest ticket marketplace and the leading global provider of enterprise tools and services for the live entertainment business, we are uniquely positioned to successfully deliver on that vision. We do it all with an intense passion for Live and an inspiring and diverse culture driven by accessible leaders, attentive managers, and enthusiastic teams. If you’re passionate about live entertainment like we are, and you want to work at a company dedicated to helping millions of fans experience it, we want to hear from you. Our Work Is Guided By Our Values Reliability - We understand that fans and clients rely on us to power their live event experiences, and we rely on each other to make it happen. Teamwork - We believe individual achievement pales in comparison to the level of success that can be achieved by a team Integrity - We are committed to the highest moral and ethical standards on behalf of the countless partners and stakeholders we represent Belonging - We are committed to building a culture in which all people can be their authentic selves, have an equal voice and opportunities to thrive EQUAL OPPORTUNITIES We are passionate and committed to our people and go beyond the rhetoric of diversity and inclusion. You will be working in an inclusive environment and be encouraged to bring your whole self to work. We will do all that we can to help you successfully balance your work and homelife. As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with. It's talent that matters to us and we encourage applications from people irrespective of their gender, race, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability status or caring responsibilities. HIRING PRACTICES The preceding job description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job. Ticketmaster recruitment policies are designed to place the most highly qualified persons available in a timely and efficient manner. Ticketmaster may pursue all avenues available, including promotion from within, employee referrals, outside advertising, employment agencies, internet recruiting, job fairs, college recruiting and search firms. Ticketmaster may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support application screening and assessment. All hiring decisions are made with human review. Live Nation Entertainment will never request payment or equipment purchases as part of the hiring process. Recruiters will only contact candidates from official Live Nation or affiliated brand email domains.
